description: Inputs to verification-plan.json that are not in the baseline or the verification rules. Freshness policies are listed strictest first; a requirement takes the strictest policy among the default, its gates' policies and its bound tests' kinds. testBindings name exact test identities per baseline obligation id, each {id, kind, categories}: categories are the evidence categories (curation/evidence-categories.json) the test fully proves for that obligation, never inferred; an unbound obligation is reported missing (contract: unbound), never guessed. exclusions must each name an authenticated operator approval in the pinned approvals file. obligationAmendments each name an authenticated operator amendment {obligation_id, action: amend, criterion, rationale} in the pinned approvals file and the owner decision it applies; the baseline text is kept verbatim beside it. derivedObligations name obligations that restate others (R5A-001-05): each clause is a whole verbatim phrase of the obligation text and names the obligations that must be verified for it; a clause with none, or marked direct because its constituents prove less than it states, is also proven by the obligation's own bound tests; connectives are the remaining words of the text, from the compiler's fixed vocabulary.

freshnessPolicies.rule: Evidence comes from a live provider or deployed-site run of the exact candidate source commit, in the run named by the ledger (run_id and source_sha match).
freshnessPolicies.reuseCondition: never reused: a new commit, a new run or a new deployment requires a new live run

freshnessPolicies.rule: Independent review evidence names the reviewed commit; it is fresh only for that commit, or for a later commit whose diff since the reviewed commit touches none of the reviewed paths, as stated by the reviewer.
freshnessPolicies.reuseCondition: not reused by the verifier; a re-review (or a reviewer's no-change attestation) is new evidence

freshnessPolicies.rule: Process and owner evidence is a record written to the run's own Praxis event log during the run (or a CI-observed owner attestation from the run), bound to the exact candidate commit; records about another candidate or another run do not count.
freshnessPolicies.reuseCondition: never reused: each candidate needs its own records; verify-process rejects evidence bound to another candidate

freshnessPolicies.rule: Evidence comes from a deterministic test (unit, property, fixture replay, offline browser) whose result depends only on its declared inputs.
freshnessPolicies.reuseCondition: reusable within one run only when the test identity and the digest of every declared input (tested source paths, fixtures, dependency lock, baseline sha256) are unchanged and Dokimos reports the evidence Reusable:true with matching id, digest and immutable revision; never reused from an earlier rehearsal
